what: a ruled loft from an 18-vertex zig-zag section to a flat 52 x 3 rectangle with 18 vertices (8 of them collinear), whose twisted ruled faces were exported as crossing triangles
method: vertex i of the bottom section is joined to vertex i of the top (same start vertex and winding), so the solid is ruled and every section is the polygon of the interpolated vertices: V = h/6 (A0 + 4 Am + A1), h = 90.5, Am the shoelace area of the averaged polygon.
